turns.query: Beijing's spring screening assumes southerly flow brings pollution and northerly flow clears it. Test that rule using March, April and May 2020-2025: report PM2.5 and PM10 in each sector and advise whether the evidence supports it.

A proposed spring trigger flags days with more southerly than northerly station-hours; ties stay unflagged. Over March-May 2020-2025, count PM10 Grade II daily exceedances and how many it misses. Which sector has dirtier typical hours, and should the desk adopt the trigger?
